levels.name: Sharp
levels.tagline: forgets a card once in a while

help.goal: Find matching pairs of cards. Whoever has taken the most pairs once the grid is clear wins.
steps: Wait for the line at the top to say it is your turn.
Tap a face-down card to flip it, then tap a second one.
A matching pair stays up and scores you a point.
Two different cards flip back and the turn moves on.
notes: Find a pair and you keep the turn, so a good run can be long.
In pass the phone mode, hand the phone to the player named at the top.
Empty seats can be filled with bots: Easy, Normal or Sharp.
